# orion ci

CI jobs whose failures cards leave out

```sh
orion ci <command> [options]
```

## orion ci list

List the CI jobs snoozed on the canvas

```sh
orion ci list [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion ci snooze

Leave a CI job's failures off every card in a repository until it passes, or until a time

```sh
orion ci snooze [name] [options]
```

| Argument          | Description                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[name]`          | The job's name, as GitHub shows it                                                                                                                                |
| `--repo <value>`  | Repository the job runs in, as owner/name (required)                                                                                                              |
| `--until <value>` | When it ends: an ISO 8601 date or date-time, in local time unless it ends in Z or an offset. Without it, the snooze lasts on each card until the job passes there |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                                                                                                                                                        |

## orion ci unsnooze

Count a snoozed CI job's failures on cards again

```sh
orion ci unsnooze [name] [options]
```

| Argument         | Description                                          |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `[name]`         | The job's name, as GitHub shows it                   |
| `--repo <value>` | Repository the job runs in, as owner/name (required) |
| `--json`         | Print JSON                                           |
